title: Aesthetics+
description: Adds quality and visual Changes that makes the game more aesthetic.
body:
## 🎉 Aesthetics+
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce758febfbfd61b1f2939f4ccd3dd0610e35dae1_0.webp)
**Aesthetics+** is a modpack that seeks to make the game more aesthetic by providing immersive visual and sound experiences with smooth animations, All while boosting your FPS.

## ✨ Features
- Performance-Optimized
- Enhanced User Interface
- Immersive Visuals Effects
- Revamped Sound Experience
- Vanilla Friendly
- Client-Side Compatibility
## 📝 Credits
- This modpack was mainly inspired by this video by [Chilley](https://www.youtube.com/@Chilley)
